patterns.documentation_structure: All documentation follows structured format with: title, date, table of contents, overview, detailed sections, code examples, verification steps, and troubleshooting
patterns.deployment_pattern: Deployment docs include pre-deployment checklist, commands, post-deployment verification, and troubleshooting
patterns.technical_depth: Documentation is comprehensive with actual file paths, command examples, and real production experience
patterns.wcag_compliance: Accessibility documentation includes WCAG standards, success criteria, testing methodology, and compliance verification
